SELECT dl.id, dl.task_id, dl.version_id, dl.execution_generation, dl.attempts, dl.failure_class, dl.failure_code, dl.error_summary, dl.status, dl.entered_at, dl.resolved_at FROM kb_parse_task_dead_letter dl WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY dl.entered_at DESC, dl.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM kb_parse_task_dead_letter dl WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT dl.id, dl.task_id, dl.version_id, dl.execution_generation, dl.attempts, dl.failure_class, dl.failure_code, dl.error_summary, dl.status, dl.entered_at, dl.resolved_at FROM kb_parse_task_dead_letter dl WHERE dl.replay_request_id = #{requestId}

WITH locked_task AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT t.id, t.version_id, t.execution_generation FROM kb_parse_task t JOIN kb_parse_task_dead_letter dl ON dl.task_id = t.id WHERE dl.id = #{deadLetterId} AND dl.status = 'OPEN' AND t.status = 'failed' AND t.execution_generation = dl.execution_generation AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id WHERE v.id = t.version_id AND v.index_status <> 'indexed' AND v.publication_evidence = 'NONE' AND d.status NOT IN ('deleted', 'archived')) FOR UPDATE OF t ), target AS ( SELECT dl.id, dl.task_id, dl.version_id FROM kb_parse_task_dead_letter dl JOIN locked_task t ON t.id = dl.task_id AND t.execution_generation = dl.execution_generation WHERE dl.id = #{deadLetterId} AND dl.status = 'OPEN' FOR UPDATE OF dl ), closed AS ( UPDATE kb_parse_task_dead_letter dl SET status = 'REPLAYED', resolved_at = now(), resolved_by = #{actorUserId}, replay_request_id = #{requestId}, resolution_reason = #{reason} FROM target t WHERE dl.id = t.id RETURNING dl.task_id, dl.version_id ), next_cycle AS ( UPDATE kb_parse_task t SET status = 'pending', attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = now(), lease_until = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, failure_class = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_summary = NULL, last_failure_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, execution_generation = t.execution_generation + 1, claim_token = t.claim_token + 1, embedding_profile_id = NULL, embedding_epoch = NULL, updated_at = now() FROM closed c WHERE t.id = c.task_id RETURNING t.id, t.version_id, t.execution_generation, t.attempts ), versions AS ( UPDATE kb_document_version SET index_status = 'pending', index_error = NULL WHERE id IN (SELECT version_id FROM next_cycle) AND index_status <> 'indexed' ), event AS ( INSERT INTO kb_parse_task_event (task_id, version_id, execution_generation, attempt_no, event_type, actor_user_id, error_summary, request_id, dedupe_key) SELECT id, version_id, execution_generation, attempts, 'REPLAYED', #{actorUserId}, #{reason}, #{requestId}, 'admin-replay:' || #{requestId} FROM next_cycle ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING ) SELECT count(*) FROM next_cycle
